question: Who among the following is the first Odissi dancer from Odisha to have received the ‘Padma Vibhushan’ in the year 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatr

 
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a well-known **guru, performer, and exponent **of Indian classical dance.
 
• He is credited with bringing back and making famous this traditional** dancing style** in the** 20th century.**
 
• He is the first recipient of the **Padma Vibhushan** award** from Odisha.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale :**

 
 
• **Dancer and choreographer **of the** Bharatanatyam style** of Indian classical dance, Rukmini Devi Arundale was an India**n theosophist.**
 
• She was the first woman to be nominated for the **Rajya Sabha **in Indian history.
 
• She was given the **Padma Bhushan in 1956, a**nd the** Sangeet Natak Akademi **Fellowship in **1967.**
 
 
 
• **Uday Shankar:**
 
 
• Uday Shankar was an** Indian dancer and choreographer.**
 
• He received a** Sangeet Natak Akademi award** in **1962.**
 
• He received the** Padma Vibhushan **honor given by the Indian government, in **1971.**
 
 
 
• **Ileana Citaristi:**
 
 
• **Italian dancer **Ileana Citaristi specializes in **chhau and odissi.**
 
• She won the **Best Choreography prize at the 1995 43rd National Film** Awards for Yugant.
 
• She received the** Padma Shri award in 2006,** being the first dancer of foreign descent to do so.
